contracts: Direct standalone grading rejects empty/missing/nonsequence authored criteria before any judge method.
Single-file grading rejects resolved empty rubric before writing output or skipping an execution-error trajectory.
Standalone CLI validates the selected known task cohort before judge construction and any grading writes.
Simple-evals preflights all authored Tasks selected by dataset IDs before replay, including tasks beyond limit.
Dataset criteria are unused for replay grading and do not override the actual authored Task rubric.
Valid nonempty rubric replay golden outcomes remain unchanged.
limitations: Unresolved task IDs and malformed trajectories retain prior handling; this change is limited to the empty-rubric contract.
Concurrent changes to task files are not locked; each grading file API revalidates its loaded task.
No models, providers, network, historical artifact writes, remote operations or commits.
